name: Challenging BIG-Bench Tasks
description: Mirac Suzgun, Nathan Scales, Nathanael Schärli, Sebastian Gehrmann, Yi Tay, Hyung Won Chung, Aakanksha Chowdhery, Quoc Le, Ed Chi, Denny Zhou, Jason Wei. Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2023. 2023.
notes: Heterogeneous collection of challenging tasks with mixed formats and metrics; varying per-task evaluation (some use exact match or retrieval metrics). Potential contamination risk from web-scale models and not a single homogeneous benchmark — scores vary widely by task.
